Experimental features
Features you can try now that may change or be removed in a patch release.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

Everything here is experimental: its commands (under `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental`), configuration (under
`experimental` in astryx.config and in an integration manifest), output, and docs may change or be removed in any patch
release, with no deprecation period. Nothing here changes what the rest of Astryx does unless you use it. A feature
leaves this section when it becomes stable.

icon-sets         [experimental] Ship an icon set: register each icon against an icon definition, so apps find icons by
                  meaning and templates use your icons.
icon-set-files    [experimental] Every field of the files an icon set is made of: the descriptor, the data file, and an
                  icon definition.
icon-definitions  [experimental] Every icon definition: what an icon stands for, and the shared name icon sets map their
                  icons to.
render-pages      Experimental. Render a page to one self-contained HTML file for sharing or embedding, and get the page
                  back from it.

Open one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/experimental/<name>
Up: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli
